source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Indicating that the client's earlier cancer treatment was ultimately unsuccessful in controlling their disease","B":"Carrying fairly little established assessment or intervention approach despite being a well-recognized survivorship concern","C":"Being an experience that essentially never occurs among people who have survived cancer treatment","D":"Is a common concern among cancer survivors that can significantly affect quality of life, warranting recognition and appropriate support"}}
source_row.rationale: Fear of cancer recurrence is a common concern among cancer survivors that can significantly affect quality of life even after successful treatment completion, warranting nursing recognition and appropriate support or referral, rather than indicating any actual treatment failure.
